sentences.text: Revision is admitted for final hearing.
Records of the Court below have been received.
The petitioner has filed I.A. No.18107/2025, an application under Section 438 of BNSS of 2023 for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The petitioner was convicted vide judgment dated 12.10.2022 passed by Judicial Magistrate First Class, Nowgaon District Chhattarpur in RCT No.118/2016 for the offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC and sentenced to RI for two years with fine of Rs.500/-, with default stipulation, which is affirmed by the Appellate Court vide judgment dated 23.07.2025 passed by the Second Additional Sessions Judge, Nowgaon District Chhattapur (M.P.) in Criminal Appeal No.36/2022.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Nowgaon District Chhattarpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Second Additional Sessions Judge, Nowgaon District Chhattapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 23.7.2025.

Considering the nature of offence as well as amount of sale consideration of the land in question,
and the fact that final hearing of this revision may take time, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, I deem it proper to suspend the jail sentence of the applicant.
2 CRR-3590-2025 It is directed that execution of jail sentence of the petitioner is hereby suspended.

It is directed that the petitioner be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 12.12.2025 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of this revision.
List the case for final hearing in due course.
